description.value: Humpback Inn is a newer, 24-room coastal motel situated in the heart of Port McNeill on northern Vancouver Island, within walking distance of the protected harbour and views of Malcolm Island. Its central location puts guests close to the marina, BC Ferries terminals, whale watching, and a scenic drive to Telegraph Cove — making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the northern tip of Vancouver Island. The property is 100% non-smoking and does not accept pets.
